name: docsobs
description: DocsObs - Sistema de Gestão de Vencimento de Documentos

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build

author: DocsObs
